protocol.initialization: absolute iid U[0,1] coordinates; Delta kept in original units; no scale-equivariance claim

protocol.control_policy: numerical acceptance AND sqrt(F/S_delta)<=tau_phi for exact-target controls only
protocol.interpretation: conditional admissible-law NEI; candidates, not exact minima or thermodynamic degeneracy

null_design.degree_sampling: independent fresh seeded chain per endpoint; finite-time kernel
null_design.gnm_failure_policy: record failure, do not substitute LCC or real graph
null_design.inference_unit: graph realization outside, attempted embedding vector inside

interpretation_limits: Finite-time degree rewiring kernel, not certified uniform connected degree ensemble.
No full-corpus claim from a three-real-network bounded study.
Admissibility is numerical; strict/global/equal-energy minima not certified.
M=100 is attempted count. Conditional empirical counts and acceptance separately reported.
Resampling intervals have no guaranteed small-sample coverage or unseen-class correction.
No automatic interpretation of a near-zero Hessian mode as a continuous family.
This payload contains newly calculated corrected-study summaries only. Legacy values are neither pooled nor silently replaced.
Exact-target controls use target-fit acceptance in addition to the numerical gate.
A missing or undefined requested null realization causes the selected-null mean, contrast and intervals to be withheld.
Graph contrasts are exploratory and not multiplicity-adjusted; bootstrap intervals are not confirmatory tests.
No prespecified numerical equivalence margin in this bounded run: tolerance equality is descriptive, not an equivalence-test verdict.

scope: bounded corrected controls + three unweighted real networks; NOT full historical sweep
